text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days after the Tracen Meet, I stop
by the training course, only
to notice the
students crowded around a certain area.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... I finished!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the students are competing with
each other in mock races. As
I look past
the winning racer, I see a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Cough... wheeze... I... finished... too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... L-looks like I lost...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was a lot of fun though! Thanks,
Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be thanking you!
But watch out! I won't lose
next time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All righty... Who should I race nex—Hm?
Ah, it's you again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No way, this is totally different! I'm dojo
storming!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I read aaall about it in a comic book! You
go up to strong people,
challenge them,
and win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The comic said that was the secret to
getting stronger, so I thought
I'd try it out!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but I just know I'll win the next one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The dojo storming continues! My next
opponent will be...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! Spe! Hey, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Urara! Are you training too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, and I came up with a new way to do
it too! Spe... I challenge
you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Challenge?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Now you've gotta race me! Come
on, Spe! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What? Right now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Haru Urara has found her next
dojo to storm. However...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Across the line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A while after Special Week finishes, an
exhausted Haru Urara
approaches the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Finished...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: N-no more...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh no, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that Haru Urara's tenacity
outmatches her stamina. While she
may
have crossed the finish line, she collapses
almost immediately
after.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew, I thought I was gonna pass out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You did pass out...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, no worries either way! I'm all rested
and ready for anything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, you really are amazing, Spe! A worthy
rival, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too cocky though! I won't lose
next time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: After seeing you run like the wind, I just know I can do the same!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right then, let's race again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm gonna hold you to that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Back to dojo storming! My next
challenge awaits! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... There she goes...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That energy of hers really is something
else. She's always so cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I always feel so bad after
losing, but Urara is ready to
accept the
next challenge no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Her fearless attitude gives me motivation
to try harder.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And talking about motivation, I better get
back to work too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's the Tracen Meet or dojo
storming, Haru Urara continues
on with a
smile, even in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it's become clear to me that her
optimism is contagious.
